questions.question: Which fearsome creature does God describe in chapter 41?
What is the point of God's description of Leviathan?
options: To teach the lesson that even the very strongest of the wild beasts can be tamed
To show that if no one can stand before this creature, none can stand before God
To reveal to Job at last the deep secret of how the wide seas were first made
To warn Job of a terrible and deadly monster lurking down in the deep dark waters
questions.answer: To show that if no one can stand before this creature, none can stand before God
